name: ppe-ledger-functions
description: Cloud Functions for the PPE Ledger app — asset create/update/retire/reactivate/delete and depreciation posting, with server-side role checks and an audit log, migrating those operations off direct client-side Firestore writes.

scripts.lint: for f in index.js assets.js depreciation.js grandfather.js backup.js lib/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
